title: Redundancy and Fail-Safe Principles from Robotics Applied to Agentic AI: A Design Pattern Study

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: survey robotics safety patterns -> map to agentic AI -> implement 3 patterns -> measure impact. The link between robotics physical-world patterns and LLM agent safety has a gap: the failure modes are quite different in nature.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires surveying ISO standards, implementing redundant verification and independent safety monitors in an agent framework, and measuring safety failure rates. Multiple advanced technical components; beginners would struggle even with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three separate pattern implementations each requiring design, build, and test. The survey alone is a deliverable but the experimental validation spans multiple independent systems. No clear single first milestone.
